objective: Fresh-seed screen of reciprocal A/B hybrids of e1p3 and e1p4 over the 130 exact-unique 2024/2025 official opponent teams from the preceding widefield study.

design.pairing: Each arm uses the same fresh panel seeds, random three-opponent groupings, battle counts, and four zombies.
design.interpretation: Exploratory hybrid screen only; any apparent winner must be tested on separately generated fresh holdout panels.
